name: CryptoPanic bearish-vote peak + oversold — news-panic capitulation reversion (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why bearish votes lead a bottom): a spike in CryptoPanic bearish votes marks the crowd piling into a pessimistic narrative on the news — the classic point of maximum fear where weak hands have already sold. Peak crowd pessimism reliably clusters near short-term price bottoms, and the vote tally registers the panic as it forms, slightly leading the price low. We require RSI oversold as the price confirmation so we fade a genuine washout, not a slow grind, and buy SPOT. Exit on RSI reverting up. DISCONFIRMER 1: if RSI-oversold alone (no vote arm) matches the deflated Sharpe, the bearish-vote spike adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: if the panic is a real regime break (a hack/ban), the reversion catches a knife — the tight stop and short max-hold are the guard; if the fit needs a wide stop to survive, the 'fade' is really a downtrend. Requires CRYPTOPANIC_API_KEY; low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: cryptopanic_bearish_votes spike (peak news pessimism) while RSI is oversold — a fear washout to fade.
